task: Made the chat sidebar drag-resizable (260-520px) via react-resizable-panels, persisted per-user in localStorage, and reconciled with the existing Ctrl+B collapse toggle.

component_scope.label: XXL
component_scope.affected: ChatPage (page-level Group/Panel wiring), Sidebar (width model removed), ChatSidebar module (new chatSidebarWidth.ts + useChatSidebarResize.ts), useSidebarOffsetClass hook, helpers.ts sidebar offset/max-width helpers, appInfo store (new setSidebarExpanded action), App bootstrap (new useChatSidebarWidthBootstrap hook)
component_scope.layers: Page component, shared component, feature hooks/utils module, shared utils, global valtio store, app bootstrap

requirements_clarity.label: L
requirements_clarity.gaps: Min/max width (260/520px) and default (308px) are not specified anywhere in the ticket -- plan.md flags them explicitly as an assumption pending product/design confirmation. The reconciliation between drag-resize and the pre-existing Ctrl+B toggle was also underspecified: the first implementation round left two competing persistence mechanisms and a stale toggle state on drag-collapse, both found and fixed only during code review (CR-001, CR-002).

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Reconciling drag-resize with an existing independent collapse mechanism (appInfoStore.sidebarExpanded / Ctrl+B) -- two state sources needing sync; useDefaultLayout's percentage-based persistence competed with the new pixel-based localStorage persistence and could desync the rendered width from the --chat-sidebar-width CSS var after a reload at a different window width (CR-001, major); drag-collapsing via the separator left the toggle button in a stale 'expanded' state requiring two clicks to recover (CR-002, major); the main-content Panel had no minSize, so dragging the sidebar to its 520px max on a narrow viewport could crush the chat content area (CR-003, major).
technical_risk.mitigation: All three correctness bugs were patched in a follow-up fix-up round: useDefaultLayout removed entirely so pixel-based localStorage is the single source of truth; appInfoStore.setSidebarExpanded(false) now called on drag-collapse (0px) to keep the toggle in sync; minSize={400} added to the main-content Panel. Re-review (code-review-check.json) confirmed all four findings resolved and approved.

key_reasoning.reason: Touched 7 distinct components spanning a page, a shared component, a new feature module, a shared hook, shared utils, the global valtio store, and the app bootstrap layer -- and two of those (helpers.ts, appInfo store) are core shared utilities, triggering the 'touches core shared utilities' red flag.
16 total files touched (6 modified + 10 new, 7 of the new files being tests), meeting the guide's XXL thresholds on both the total-touched and new-file counts.

Ticket left min/max/default width unspecified (implementer's own plan.md flags it as an unconfirmed assumption), and the toggle-reconciliation design was ambiguous enough that the first implementation round shipped two real desync bugs caught only in review.

Reconciling a new drag-resize mechanism with a pre-existing independent collapse toggle produced three major-severity correctness bugs (competing persistence sources, stale toggle state, unbounded content crush), all requiring a dedicated fix-up round before approval.

Requirements Clarity bumped from M to L: vague acceptance criteria -- no min/max/default width specified in the ticket, flagged as an assumption in plan.md
